currentUserGoal: Tune the normal active first run after feedback that HP drain still felt too slow during play.
summary: Measured normal active play with DOM root clicks at a human-ish cadence, prioritizing wounded roots and using Dew Pulse only below 32 HP.
Before tuning, active play was still alive after 121 seconds, had earned 311 RT, used Dew Pulse 8 times, and had not reached dormancy.
Reduced manual normal root healing from 5 to 3 HP.
Reduced wounded-root manual healing from 16 to 10 HP.
Raised Dew Pulse from 18 RT / 12 HP to 22 RT / 10 HP.
Changed permanent GT conversion from 1:1 effective healing to 1 permanent GT per 5 effective HP.
After tuning, the same active-play smoke reached dormancy in 88 seconds, earned 160 RT, used Dew Pulse 7 times, and paid +49 permanent GT.
Updated design and implementation docs to reflect the current Dew Pulse and permanent conversion numbers.
verification: npm run test passed after updating Dew Pulse and payout expectations.
npm run check passed: lint, 27 tests, and build.
Browser active-play smoke after final tuning: dormancy at 88 seconds, 95 root clicks, 7 Dew Pulse uses, 160 RT earned, 6 unspent RT, +49 Permanent GT, meta screen visible, and no warn/error logs.
knownIssues: The first-run objective expansion still reaches 5x5 very quickly, around 11-12 seconds in automated active play.
Dew Pulse is now useful but still fired 7 times in the measured run; future tuning may want a cooldown or stronger scarcity if it feels spammy by hand.
The first active-run payout of about 49 GT may still be generous, but it no longer buys the whole early tree at once.
This pass measured DOM-button play, not a human hand on the canvas, so final feel still needs user playtesting.
nextRecommendedSteps: Have the user play the normal route by hand and report time-to-dormancy, whether Dew Pulse feels spammy, and whether +49 GT feels too generous.
Consider slowing first-run field expansion so the player has more time with 1x1, 2x2, and 3x3 before the full 5x5 board.
Make the Game Over/meta screen communicate the 1 GT per 5 effective HP conversion so the reward feels legible.
Add a small post-purchase feedback line that says what changed for the next run.
doNotRevert: Do not restore 5/16 manual healing unless intentionally returning to the slower active prototype feel.
Do not restore 1:1 permanent GT conversion unless the meta tree costs are completely rebalanced upward.
Do not restore Dew Pulse to the cheap 8 RT version from older docs.
